objectives.text: Write versioned Flyway migrations named V<version>__<description>.sql that create and change tables, and let Spring Boot apply them at startup
Predict what Flyway does on startup for a new migration, an already applied migration and an edited applied migration (checksum mismatch)
Explain why schema changes go in a new migration and why spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is set to validate or none once Flyway owns the schema

This worst path was modeled, not measured on these pages. budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, within the 15 minute cap.
